scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@qiconect/contracts && concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev --workspace=@qiconect/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@qiconect/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@qiconect/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@qiconect/api && npm run build --workspace=@qiconect/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@qiconect/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@qiconect/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@qiconect/web
